# Coordinator operation reference

Each catalog operation has an input contract, the type its adapter decodes, and an output contract, the type its adapter returns as the step output. A mapping that feeds a call must produce a value its input contract accepts; a reference into a call step's output must name a path its output contract declares.

| Operation | Version | Product | Effect | Key | Preparation | Recovery | Receipt |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`read-record`](#read-record) | 1 | `breg` | read | none | none | read-again | none |
| [`submit-message`](#submit-message) | 1 | `messaging` | mutation | required | none | same-command-and-receipt | read |
| [`read-scheduling`](#read-scheduling) | 1 | `scheduling` | read | none | none | read-again | none |
| [`read-availability`](#read-availability) | 1 | `scheduling` | read | none | none | read-again | none |
| [`create-appointment`](#create-appointment) | 1 | `scheduling` | mutation | required | none | same-command-and-receipt | read |
| [`invoke-breg-action`](#invoke-breg-action) | 1 | `breg` | mutation | required | required | same-command | none |
| [`external-get`](#external-get) | 1 | `external-http` | read | none | none | read-again | none |
| [`evaluate-decision`](#evaluate-decision) | 1 | `decision` | evaluation | none | required | hold-after-dispatch | none |
| [`submit-review-request`](#submit-review-request) | 1 | `casework` | mutation | required | none | same-command | none |
| [`cancel-review-request`](#cancel-review-request) | 1 | `casework` | mutation | required | none | same-command | none |

## Wait events

A wait-for step waits for one event. When the event arrives, the step continues with `next` and holds the event as its output, so a reference into a wait-for step's output must name a path the event contract declares. A step reached by `onTimeout` reads no event.

### review-result
